meanings.usage: 形容词，用来描述价格高的物品
表示过去发生的购买行为
指穿戴衣物或配饰，过去式为wore
可数名词，指戴在头上的服饰
对男士的礼貌称呼，复数为gentlemen
stand的现在分词，用作形容词

phrases.usage: 立即，马上，表示立即做某事

examples.en: Why didn't you tell me straight away?
examples.zh: 你为什么不立刻告诉我？

phrases.usage: 穿上，戴上，表示穿上衣服或戴上帽子等

examples.en: Would you put it on, please?

phrases.usage: 我不记得了，表示遗忘或记不起某事
谁接待了您？用于询问服务人员
我现在认出他了，表示辨认出某人

examples.en: I didn't recognize you at first.

grammar.title: 定语从句（Relative Clauses）- 关系代词who/which/that
grammar.definition: 定语从句用于修饰名词或代词，由关系代词who（指人）、which（指物）或that引导 用于限制性定语从句中，修饰先行词，明确指出是哪个人或物

examples.en: The man who bought these books came back.
examples.zh: 买这些书的那个人回来了。

examples.en: The books which are on the counter are expensive.
The lady who is standing behind the counter served me.
examples.zh: 站在柜台后面的那位女士接待了我。

grammar.title: 过去进行时（Past Continuous Tense）
grammar.definition: 过去进行时表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作 用于描述过去正在发生的事件，或与另一个过去动作进行对比

examples.en: The man I served was wearing a hat.
examples.zh: 我接待的那个人当时戴着一顶帽子。

examples.en: She was standing behind the counter when I came in.
examples.zh: 我进来时她正站在柜台后面。

imitations.zh: 今天早上谁给你打电话了？

patterns.pattern: Did + 主语 + 动词原形 + ...?

original.en: Did you serve this gentleman half an hour ago?
original.zh: 半小时前你接待了这位先生吗？

imitations.en: Did you see the movie last night?
imitations.zh: 你昨晚看了那部电影吗？

patterns.pattern: The + 名词 + who/which + 句子

original.en: The man who I served was wearing a hat.
original.zh: 我接待的那个人当时戴着一顶帽子。

imitations.en: The book which I bought is very interesting.
The student who studies hard got good grades.
imitations.zh: 努力学习的学生取得了好成绩。

original.en: Would you put it on, please?

imitations.en: Would you open the door, please?

lines.en: I bought two expensive dictionaries here half an hour ago, but I forgot to take them with me.

lines.en: Who served you, sir?

lines.speaker: Customer

lines.en: Which books did you buy?

lines.en: Did you serve this gentleman half an hour ago, Miss Roberts?
He says he’s the man who bought these books.

lines.speaker: Miss Roberts
lines.en: I can’t remember, sir. The man whom I served was wearing a hat.

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.en: Have you got a hat, sir?

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.en: Yes, I have.

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.en: Would you put it on, please?

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.en: All right.

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.en: Is this the man that you served, Miss Roberts?

lines.speaker: Miss Roberts
lines.en: Yes, sir. I recognize him now.
This is the car which the mechanic repaired yesterday.
He is the man whom I invited to the party.
These are the things which I bought yesterday.
He is the man who came here last week.
He is the policeman who caught the thieves.
She is the nurse who looked after me.
She is the woman whom I met at the party.
I am the person who wrote to you.

Yes, she's the woman who met him.

Yes, he's the man who sat there.

Yes, he's the man who read it.

Yes, he's the man who shut it.

Yes, she's the woman who took it.
Who told me? That man?
Yes, he's the man who told me.
Who saw me? That woman?
Yes, she's the woman who saw me.
C Whom did you see? That man?
Yes, he's the man whom I saw.
Whom did you telephone? That woman?
Yes, she's the woman whom I telephoned.
Whom did you invite? That man?
Yes, he's the man whom I invited.
Whom did you take to the cinema? That man?
Yes, he's the man whom I took to the cinema.
Whom did you find in the garden? That man?
Yes, he's the man whom I found in the garden.
Whom did you drive to London? That woman?
Yes, she's the woman whom I drove to London.
Whom did you hear? That woman?
Yes, she's the woman whom I heard.
Whom did you remember? That man?
Yes, he's the man whom I remembered.

translation:
顾 客：半小时以前我在这里买了两本很
贵的辞典，但是我忘了拿走。
经 理：是谁接待您的，先生？
顾 客：站在柜台后面的那位女士。
经 理：您买的是两本什么书？
顾 客：就是柜台上的那两本。
经 理：卡罗琳，半小时前你接待过这位先生
吗？他说他就是买这两本书的人。
卡罗琳：我记不起来了。我接待的那个人戴着
一顶帽子。
经 理：先生，您有帽子吗？
顾 客：有的，我有帽子。
经 理：请您把帽子戴上好吗？
顾 客：好吧。
经 理：卡罗琳，
这就是你接待过的那个人吗？
卡罗琳：是他。我现在认出他来了。
